heading.zh-Hant: 出身、求學與合作社事業

body.zh-Hant: 圖貝利斯1882年4月18日生於羅基什基斯一帶，家境富裕，父親是精力充沛的農民。他還是學生時就參與民族解放運動，後來在里加理工學院修完農學。立陶宛恢復獨立、組成臨時政府時，他受邀出任農業與國有財產部長。1920至1927年間，他與他人合力建立經濟組織，並領導其中幾個。
body.en: Tūbelis was born on 18 April 1882 near Rokiškis, in the family of a well-off and energetic farmer. As a pupil he already took part in the national liberation movement, and he later completed agronomy at the Riga Polytechnic Institute. When the Provisional Government was formed after Lithuania regained independence, he was invited to serve as Minister of Agriculture and State Property. From 1920 to 1927 he worked with others to build economic organisations and led some of them.

body.zh-Hant: 1927年5月3日起，財政部長一職由圖貝利斯擔任。1929年9月19日，總統不得不撤換當時的政府首腦，圖貝利斯被任命為總理；他自9月23日起出任總理，直到1938年3月24日他領導的第17屆內閣辭職。擔任總理期間，他保留財政部長職位，並一度代理外交部長。他任財政部長逾10年，任政府首腦8年半。
body.en: From 3 May 1927 the post of Minister of Finance went to Tūbelis. On 19 September 1929 the president had no choice but to dismiss the head of government, and Tūbelis was appointed prime minister; he held the office from 23 September 1929 until 24 March 1938, when the 17th cabinet under his leadership resigned. While prime minister he kept the finance portfolio and for a time also acted as foreign minister. He was finance minister for more than ten years and head of government for eight and a half.

body.zh-Hant: 1931年6月1日，總理圖貝利斯成為立陶宛民族主義者聯盟（LTS）的主席；聯盟與政府形成事實上的人事合一。1933年12月15日聯盟大會改組，主席改由總統斯梅托納任命，圖貝利斯獲確認留任。1931至1938年間他兼任這兩個職務；1938年3月24日米羅納斯出任總理，1939年1月5日接手聯盟主席。
body.en: On 1 June 1931 Prime Minister Tūbelis became chairman of the Lithuanian Nationalist Union (LTS), and the union and the government formed a de facto personal union. When the LTS was reformed at its congress on 15 December 1933, the chairmanship became an appointment of President Smetona, and Tūbelis was confirmed in it. He held both posts from 1931 to 1938; V. Mironas became prime minister on 24 March 1938 and took over the union chairmanship on 5 January 1939.

heading.zh-Hant: 財政政策與立陶宛銀行行長
heading.en: Financial policy and governor of the Bank of Lithuania

body.zh-Hant: 圖貝利斯的財政政策要點是預算平衡、高度節約、抑制非生產性開支、避免外債，整個內閣的經濟政策都以維持立特幣值穩定為導向。1938年10月1日他被任命為立陶宛銀行第三任行長，領導銀行恰好一年，到1939年9月30日去世。
body.en: The main points of Tūbelis's financial policy were a balanced state budget, great frugality, restraint of unproductive spending and the avoidance of foreign debt, and the economic policy of his whole government was oriented towards preserving the stability of the litas. He was appointed third governor of the Bank of Lithuania on 1 October 1938 and led the bank for exactly one year, until his death on 30 September 1939.

heading.en: Origins and entry to the Chamber

body.zh-Hant: 杜梅格1863年8月1日生於加爾省的艾格維夫，出身新教家庭。他1885年登記為尼姆的律師，1890年被任命為印度支那的法官。1893年12月17日，他在尼姆第二選區當選眾議員，並加入激進社會黨團；總統府年表稱他為尼姆的激進派議員。
body.en: Doumergue was born on 1 August 1863 at Aigues-Vives in the Gard, into a Protestant family. He enrolled at the Nîmes bar in 1885 and was appointed a judge in Indochina in 1890. On 17 December 1893 he was elected deputy for the second constituency of Nîmes and joined the radical-socialist group; the presidential chronology calls him a radical deputy for Nîmes.

heading.zh-Hant: 殖民、商業與公共教育部長
heading.en: Minister of Colonies, Commerce and Public Instruction

body.zh-Hant: 1902年6月7日，杜梅格在孔布政府出任殖民地部長，任至1905年1月23日。1906年3月14日他改掌商業、工業與勞動，其後職稱為商業與工業部長；1908年1月4日轉任公共教育與美術部長，任期到1910年11月2日。任內他為把左拉的骨灰移入先賢祠辯護。1910年3月6日，他在補選中當選加爾省參議員。
body.en: On 7 June 1902 Doumergue became Minister of the Colonies in the Combes government, serving until 23 January 1905. On 14 March 1906 he took Commerce, Industry and Labour, later styled Commerce and Industry; on 4 January 1908 he moved to Public Instruction and Fine Arts, serving until 2 November 1910. In that office he defended the transfer of Zola's ashes to the Panthéon. On 6 March 1910 he was elected senator for the Gard in a by-election.

body.en: In the Senate Doumergue joined the democratic-left radical and radical-socialist group and was re-elected in 1912. At the end of 1913 President Poincaré called on him to form a cabinet, in which he combined the offices of President of the Council and Foreign Minister, from 9 December 1913 to 8 June 1914.

body.en: During the First World War Doumergue was Foreign Minister from 3 to 26 August 1914 and then, from 26 August 1914 until 19 March 1917, Minister of the Colonies. In the latter capacity he represented France at the inter-allied conference in Saint Petersburg.

heading.en: Senate President, President of the Republic and second premiership

body.zh-Hant: 1923年2月22日，杜梅格在參議院第二輪投票中當選議長，接替退任的布儒瓦。1924年6月13日他當選共和國總統，七年任期到1931年屆滿。1934年2月，二月六日的暴動過後，他被召回再任內閣總理，11月8日辭職並退出政壇。他1937年6月18日在艾格維夫去世。
body.en: On 22 February 1923 Doumergue was elected President of the Senate at the second ballot, replacing Léon Bourgeois, who had given up the office. He was elected President of the Republic on 13 June 1924, and his seven-year term ended in 1931. In February 1934, after the riot of 6 February, he was recalled to serve again as President of the Council; he resigned on 8 November and withdrew from political life. He died at Aigues-Vives on 18 June 1937.

heading.en: President of the Council of Ministers and accession

body.zh-Hant: 賽義德·本·泰穆爾自1929年起擔任父親泰穆爾蘇丹的大臣會議主席，在父親長期不在馬斯喀特時實際主持政府。1932年泰穆爾因財政因素退位，他依原定計畫繼位，於2月10日成為馬斯喀特與阿曼的蘇丹；據美國國會圖書館的研究，當時22歲的他接手的是一個負債的行政體系。
body.en: Said bin Taimur had served as President of his father Sultan Taimur's Council of Ministers since 1929, effectively in charge of the government during his father's prolonged absences from Muscat. When Taimur abdicated for financial reasons in 1932, he succeeded him, as had been planned, becoming Sultan of Muscat and Oman on 10 February 1932; according to the Library of Congress study, the 22-year-old inherited an administration that was in debt.

body.zh-Hant: 美國國務院1938年2月的一份公報描述這位年輕蘇丹接手時的處境：國家幾近破產，部落騷動，又有他幾位叔伯的陰謀，其中一人隨即趁機另立獨立政權。公報說，蘇丹果斷處理，不久即制服了那位叔父、平息動亂，最重要的是使國家財政穩固得多。
body.en: A United States Department of State bulletin of February 1938 describes the situation the young sultan found: the country practically bankrupt, tribal unrest, and conspiracy by certain of his uncles, one of whom immediately set up an independent regime. According to the bulletin the sultan tackled the situation with resolution and within a short time subdued the uncle, quelled the unrest and, most important, put state finances on a much more solid footing.

heading.en: State-building and the conflict in the interior

body.zh-Hant: 劍橋大學出版社的專書指出，1932至1959年間蘇丹賽義德設法建立統一國家，同時盡量減少對英國的依賴，卻仍倚靠英方的政治與軍事支持來確保統一與獨立。1954年PDO派探勘隊進入內陸，部落長老視之為違反1920年《錫卜條約》，同年選出新的伊瑪目，開始分離運動；英國介入支持蘇丹，到1959年重建了他的權威，並廢除該條約、終結伊瑪目職位。
body.en: The Cambridge University Press study says that from 1932 to 1959 Sultan Said oversaw a complex and difficult attempt to forge a unified state while limiting its dependence on the British, even while relying on their political and military support to secure its unity and independence. In 1954 the PDO sent exploration teams into the interior, which the tribal shaykhs read as a violation of the 1920 Treaty of As Sib; a new imam was elected that year and a secessionist movement began. The British intervened on behalf of the sultan and by 1959 had re-established his authority, abrogated the treaty and ended the office of imam.

body.zh-Hant: 1958年之後，賽義德把居所設在佐法爾的薩拉拉附近的哈斯恩，除了定期造訪倫敦，長住於此。據美國國會圖書館的研究，退居南方使他較不易遇刺，也不必頻繁接見部落長老、發放補助，以免耗盡國庫。劍橋的專書則指出，他對他的統治的負面評價，多半來自他退居薩拉拉的統治最後十年。
body.en: After 1958 Said established his residence at Al Hisn near Salalah in Dhofar, where he remained permanently except for periodic visits to London. According to the Library of Congress study, retiring to the south made him more secure from assassination and spared him from meeting tribal shaykhs and distributing subsidies, thereby avoiding depleting the treasury. The Cambridge study adds that much of the negative reputation of his reign derives from its last decade, when he had withdrawn to Salalah.
